hotels.title: USA: Boutique Minneapolis Retreat Overlooking Lake Minnetonka with Restaurant & Day Spa
hotels.description: Immerse yourself in lakeside luxury of The Hotel Landing, a stylish retreat nestled in the heart of Wayzata, just minutes from downtown Minneapolis. This chic boutique hotel offers an exquisite blend of comfort and sophistication, with Lake Minnetonka's sparkling waters just a stone's throw away. Indulge in the culinary delights of the on-site ninetwentyfive restaurant or explore the vibrant local dining scene. Venture out on a leisurely stroll along the picturesque Lake Street and return to the relaxing sanctuary of Läka Spa to unwind as you please.
